name: traintravel-platform
description: TrainTravel Enterprise Microservices Railway Booking Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix user-service && npm install --prefix search-service && npm install --prefix admin-service && npm install --prefix inventory-service && npm install --prefix booking-service && npm install --prefix payment-service && npm install --prefix notification-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.prisma:generate: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); ['user-service','admin-service','inventory-service','booking-service','payment-service'].forEach(s => execSync('npx prisma generate', { cwd: s, stdio: 'inherit' }))"
scripts.prisma:push: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); ['user-service','admin-service','inventory-service','booking-service','payment-service'].forEach(s => execSync('npx prisma db push', { cwd: s, stdio: 'inherit' }))"
